LanguageData.RM_CondenserStirsText: The season is turning and the great stone-crab is gathering itself to move. The pool around it has begun to drain. You have a day to decide what to do about it.
LanguageData.RM_CondenserOptGuide: Guide it onto your land for a season
LanguageData.RM_CondenserOptSell: Sell where it will settle next
LanguageData.RM_CondenserOptCut: Cut the machine out (kills the gorrask)
LanguageData.RM_CondenserDryingText: The gorrask is moving on and the pool it carried is draining back into the ground over the coming days.
LanguageData.RM_CondenserGuideLabel: The gorrask will come to you
LanguageData.RM_CondenserGuideText: The gorrask has been lured toward your land. When it settles, a pool and the water truce will form round it for a season.
LanguageData.RM_CondenserGuideNoSite: There is no reachable ground on your land for the gorrask to settle on.
LanguageData.RM_CondenserSellNoBuyer: No faction friendly enough wants to buy the gorrask's next settling place.
LanguageData.RM_CondenserSellText: {0} has paid {1} silver for the right to the gorrask's next season. Their settlement will have the pool for that season; you will not.
LanguageData.RM_CondenserCutText: The gorrask is dead and its condenser lies free of the shell. The moving oasis is over for good, and this is the last working condenser anywhere.
LanguageData.RM_CondenserInspectWalking: Moving to a new settling place.
